description: Layer 2 - Backend Data: Fix conversation history cache invalidation, add dead letter replay mechanism, remove redundant Redis search cache
steps: 1. In apps/backend/app/services/chat_service.py, modify save_chat() method: REPLACE the proactive cache warm logic (the try block that updates history cache after saving) with a call to _invalidate_history_cache(session_id). The _invalidate_history_cache method already exists and deletes cache keys for max_turns values 5 and 10. This ensures stale data is evicted and next read refills from MongoDB.

2. In apps/backend/app/services/dead_letter.py, extend the module with: (a) An async function list_dead_letters(page: int, page_size: int, status_filter: Optional[str]) that queries MongoDB dead_letters collection with pagination and optional status filter. (b) An async function replay_dead_letter(dead_letter_id: str) that fetches a dead letter by ID, marks it as 'retrying', re-submits the message through ChatService (non-streaming call_llm), and marks it as 'retried' on success or 'retry_failed' on failure. (c) Add status field options: 'pending', 'retrying', 'retried', 'retry_failed', 'expired'.
3. In apps/backend/app/services/dead_letter.py, in store_dead_letter(), ensure the document includes 'status': 'pending' (already exists) and add 'retry_count': 0 field.

4. Create a new router file apps/backend/app/api/v1/admin_dead_letters.py with: (a) GET /dead-letters endpoint (paginated, requires admin session) that calls list_dead_letters(). (b) POST /dead-letters/{id}/replay endpoint (requires admin session + CSRF) that calls replay_dead_letter(). (c) Follow the pattern in admin_content.py for _validate_admin_session and _csrf_check usage.
5. In apps/backend/app/main.py, import and register the new admin_dead_letters router with prefix='/api/v1/admin' and tags=['Admin Dead Letters'].

6. In apps/backend/app/services/search/azure_search.py, make the Redis search cache CONFIGURABLE and DISABLED by default. Add a setting SEARCH_CACHE_ENABLED: bool = False in config.py. In search_context(), wrap the cache read and cache write blocks with 'if settings.SEARCH_CACHE_ENABLED:' checks. This effectively removes the cache without deleting the code (allows re-enabling if needed).
acceptance_criteria: save_chat() invalidates history cache instead of warming it with potentially stale data
Dead letter service has list_dead_letters() and replay_dead_letter() functions
New admin endpoint GET /api/v1/admin/dead-letters returns paginated dead letters
New admin endpoint POST /api/v1/admin/dead-letters/{id}/replay re-submits message
Azure Search Redis cache is disabled by default (SEARCH_CACHE_ENABLED=False)
All Python files pass AST parsing
